description: Scan a directory and report what mockzilla can do with it: top-level OpenAPI spec files (with title and endpoint count) plus any folders of static endpoint files mockzilla can serve. Returns a `suggested_input` the agent can hand directly to `serve_locally`. Use this when the user says 'I have a folder of specs/files, what's in it?' or 'mock this directory'. Scans one level only: on a tree of spec folders it names the subdirectories to recurse into. A big folder is summarised up to a cap, with `truncated: true` and the full `spec_file_count`.
name: discover_specs
